notes.title: Developer Update – Building, Combat, Lore, and More!
notes.notes:
Greetings Seekers,
The ritual continues. Shadows lengthen on Farmouth Island as our team weaves new systems, summons darker threats, and breathes life into every corner of the world you’ve come to haunt. This is your glimpse into what’s next for The Bornless…



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_4db899471c5f4916888315fcfa831fd9~mv2.gif"]
BUILDING SYSTEM – YOUR DOMAIN, YOUR DESIGN
Our Building System is nearly ready for prime time, letting you transform resources and scrap gathered on Farmouth Island into structures, fortifications, and decorations for your personal island.

Whether you want a practical fortress or something purely aesthetic, you can place items with snap, grid-align, or freeform precision—right down to putting furniture in mid-air if you wish.

Structures can be rotated, demolished on the fly, and rebuilt to your liking. We’ve built this system around freedom—unlike many games, there are no strict build zones, so your creativity sets the limits.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_cf9b243774ad4a828b04e1ae822a0f24~mv2.gif"]
MOTORBIKE – RIDE THE STORM
From concept sketch to roaring reality, we’re thrilled to introduce a Motorbike that prowls the wilds. Functional headlights, brake lights, fuel and speed gauges—it’s as much atmosphere as it is transportation.

Tear through the swamps under moonlight, or kill the lights and vanish into shadow before the hunt begins.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_a09a644459d2479784310c1357f6ab01~mv2.gif"]
THE BORNLESS TAROT DECK
A deck born of black magick—rubber-hose style art depicting demons, angels, and mortals of our realm.

Ten cards already exist, each carrying hidden lore and whispered secrets. One day, the deck will be whole… and perhaps, usable both in-game and in the physical world.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_f844dab8fd8b447dbc10733db3ddf994~mv2.gif"]
RADIO TOWER – THE HEART OF CONFLICT
At the centre of the map rises the Radio Tower: a labyrinth of corridors wide enough for the largest demons, choke points perfect for ambush.

This fortress-like landmark will also play host to puzzles, quests, and mini-games, with interconnected spaces designed to support future gameplay mechanics—like locked-door logic puzzles and scavenger-style objectives.

We’re really excited for you to unleash hell here!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_2db3b769c02d4ffb8fb62730623bc63a~mv2.gif"]NEW HOUSES – LURKING HISTORY
Our homes now carry the salt-worn bones of Lovecraftian New England.

We’ve overhauled our house designs to better match the atmosphere of Farmouth Island, drawing inspiration from Lovecraftian interiors and New England coastal architecture. These homes are more open inside, allowing demons to enter and stir chaos, but still filled with nooks and crannies for humans to hide and plan their next move.

These new houses will be making their way onto the island very soon!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_d23769b02dbe416aa34dc523f37119ac~mv2.gif"]
CORRUPTION & NEW ENEMIES
Dwell too long in the island’s grip and you will change—ashen skin, glowing eyes, and torn remnants of who you once were. Through progression you will be able to unlock new dark variation of your chosen character — marking you as a battle-hardened veteran.

As well as these dark variations we are also introducing new horrors, Shoggoths – Failed angelic experiments dripping with rage.

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_9c68149c061545fda3eadd6b40b90462~mv2.gif"]

Stillborn – Motionless until your back is turned… then lightning-fast.

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_a447e2cd43524b6ca60fd5574a1bb518~mv2.gif"]

Brains – Their exposed brains make them fragile, but they can fly with rapid speed and have a deadly bite.

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_772bda7959c34d7caec7b522ccc3f0cc~mv2.gif"]

Tentacles & Growths – Silent horrors that wait in the dark.

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_fb9922609e89487989fab41880a008db~mv2.gif"]

Wardens – Floating titans wielding divine judgment.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_ac45f2b8cc1049bba7c15e131f7ca626~mv2.gif"]
MELEE SYSTEM OVERHAUL
The melee system you all experienced in the Next Fest build was unfinished, and we listened to your feedback to make sure whatever we worked on felt just right.

We’ve rebuilt the Melee System from the ground up. The old “hold to charge” mechanic is gone, replaced with intuitive light attacks and unique special attacks per weapon. Updated animations, on-screen blood effects, and hit-stop feedback make every strike feel heavier and more satisfying.

There are a few other additions to the melee system and we’re really excited for you to try them out!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_f1821135aae148fd8782449434076b28~mv2.gif"]
GUNPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
Your feedback was clear: the gunplay needed more weight. Now, pistols are snappy, sniper rifles deliberate, and movement shifts depending on your weapon’s heft.

Weapon sway, smoother transitions, and tactile recoil bring the chaos to life.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_ece93797def34262a83b513d0f40696f~mv2.gif"]
THE GREAT SWAMP OF ZABOSLAV
This optional side quest zone introduces one of the many realms belonging to the island’s mysterious entities.

Heavy with mist and menace, shrines, hidden lore of Zaboslav, and rewards for the brave. But be warned—Haag and his kin guard it well.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_d3c8d17c749c4b6bbc8397ae0d7f5535~mv2.gif"]
UNREAL ENGINE 5.6 UPGRADE
Performance was one of the biggest pieces of feedback that we received post-Next Fest and one we were hyper aware of too. So, we have now moved from UE 5.4 to UE 5.6 as part of our ongoing performance push.

The upgrade brings better stability, optimized Lumen and virtual shadow maps, improved hardware ray tracing, and new tools for animation, 3D assets, and Metahuman creation—keeping The Bornless at the forefront of modern tech.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_f935438e1420476c92ff91f02b4d6d1e~mv2.gif"]
SPELL CRAFTING RETURNS
Curses are back.

The return of Curses comes with a full Spell Crafting System. Gather ingredients—from herbs and oils to more grotesque finds—across Farmouth Island, extract them safely, and combine them at the spell crafting bench.

Discover powerful spells through experimentation, with rare recipes rewarding creativity and exploration.

This still needs a bit more time, but we’re really excited to be bringing this back very soon!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]
OUR COMMUNITIES DEEP DIVE
Over the past weeks, our Creators and Partners have been hard at work conjuring unholy content — sharing gameplay, lore, and even exclusive developer updates.

We want to shine a light on their efforts, give them a proper shoutout, and invite you to watch their creations.

This video from Firewitch74, one of our Partners, is a must-watch — a super in-depth breakdown of fresh updates coming to The Bornless. If you want the latest, this is where to start.
[previewyoutube="6JGurpNjWgg;full"][/previewyoutube]


TiredEyeBags gives you the rundown on The Bornless — what to expect, how to survive, and how to escape the fog.
[previewyoutube="9_IgsOamN_k;full"][/previewyoutube]


A truly unique edit from Rusticmoon VR — diving into the dark mythos of The Bornless and the Ritual itself. This one’s special.
[previewyoutube="oIfrCMvjlmQ;full"][/previewyoutube]


For our Spanish-speaking Seekers — Alma_Caninaa shares thoughts and reactions to the latest The Bornless updates.
[previewyoutube="SH1CifiIsKA;full"][/previewyoutube]


A hot take: “The Bornless is the Extraction Horror Game that changed everything.”

Not our words — but those of HonestlyBretter.
[previewyoutube="xtLUukhGGeg;full"][/previewyoutube]


AbsurdNerdz is doing all she can to summon a new playtest… maybe she knows something we don’t? 👀 Watch Here

We are endlessly grateful to every Creator and Partner who continues to keep the flame alive with their videos, streams, and edits.

Seekers — watch their work, drop them a follow, and show them some love. This community wouldn’t exist without you.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/d1b1f59bad220bc6df2f7b3586b27271ed5be6df.png"]
PRE-REGISTRATION EVENT NOW LIVE
Don’t forget our Pre-Registration Event is still live.

Sign up and help unlock exclusive rewards for launch: 

https://thebornless.com/preregister



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"]

The island changes. The air grows heavier. The Ritual waits for no one.

We see you. We hear you. And we cannot wait to witness the chaos you bring next.



#StayUnholy 

- The Bornless Team 🖤

notes.title: Developer Update - What's New in The Bornless?
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Seekers.

Let’s get you caught up, shall we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/0b1f4a9d9f6520dcd32df97f68564cdb71d710d7.png

Last week we announced our upcoming “Fractured Souls” playtest and detailed how you can get your hands on a Key if you haven’t got one already! 

📅 Playtest Dates: June 7th – 8th
⏰ 48 Hours of Continuous Server Uptime

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/5426764685722ba7ce3f1a48bc8914651811558e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/fa8c71c20afb647ef658963f725d1dcd528fa58a.png

We invited you all to the first Town Hall we have hosted in quite a while! This one will be juicy. Join us in Discord as our CEO, Head of Game, and Head of Community break down everything that's coming up for The Bornless. The likelihood of secrets being leaked is high... you have been warned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/7904b69a0e8b290856e17de94e847dd4aa7d122e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/199d59be5f21f5314728b01c0265001ad0ad251d.png

Prepare to return to Farmouth Island in the most ambitious version of The Bornless we’ve ever released. The "Fractured Souls" update introduces new characters, new systems, massive visual improvements, and more, in preparation for the playtest and then Steam Next Fest!
Here’s everything you can expect in the latest build:

48-Hour Server Uptime
For the first time, during our playtest The Bornless servers will be open continuously for 48 hours, giving players around the world the opportunity to dive in early. Why join now instead of waiting for Steam Next Fest? We’re glad you asked...

Persistent Account Progression
With 10 Playable Characters and 3 Playable Demons to unlock, getting in early means getting ahead. All inventory and unlocks from this playtest will carry forward into Steam Next Fest. So, if you want a head start, this is your moment.

Seekers & Demons
Whether you prefer stealth, chaos, precision, or destruction, there’s a Seeker for every playstyle, and a Demon to match. Each playable Demon offers a unique set of abilities, giving you the power to terrorize and dominate your enemies in entirely new ways.

Trading & Quests with Haag
Scarcity defines the gameplay in The Bornless, and that’s where Haag comes in. Haag is your connection between matches, offering fresh quests and trade opportunities for precious Gold. Complete tasks or barter junk for rare items to improve your odds of survival.

Visual Overhaul
The entire game has undergone a huge visual upgrade. We’ve enabled Nanite, Lumen, and hardware ray tracing, offering higher fidelity models, better lighting, sharper shadows, and stunning reflections.

More Secrets…
Farmouth Island continues to evolve. From hidden Enigmas and ancient crypts to entirely new locations and enhanced enemy behaviors, there’s always something lurking in the fog.

The only way to uncover the truth? Join us in the ritual.

#StayUnholy
- The Bornless Team 🖤

notes.title: Developer Update: Localization
notes.notes:
Welcome back to our Developer Update series!

This week, we’re breaking down how one feature alone can help to ensure that our next playtest is more accessible than ever before.

We sat down with Mike, Narrative Designer at Cathedral Studios, to learn more:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/c08b070076aa87a6ef24876cab1d13cc3ac76a15.png

What is Localization?

In simple terms, localization is the act of translating our game to support our international gamers' local languages. There is more to it than that, of course; not everything can be perfectly translated! But that is the top-level concept: to ensure that players in regions where English is not their first language are just as able to play and enjoy The Bornless as anyone else.

Why is Localization so important?

Inclusion and accessibility are incredibly important to us at Cathedral Studios. Localization goes beyond simply translating words 1:1, as that can lead to some seriously janky translations! What we try to do is adapt the phrasing and sentences to suit the language we're translating into—that way, we're able to communicate the same concepts and ideas without key information getting lost in translation (pun absolutely intended).

How are we implementing Localization in The Bornless?

As a small studio, we must recognize our strengths and our talents. We have a number of team members who speak various languages (French, Spanish, Danish, Serbian, to name but a few) whom we can lean on to sense-check and QA test some of our localization. For other languages, we'll need to rely on consultants who can plug the gaps in our knowledge.

How do we decide which languages to prioritize?

Until we have the resources to localize The Bornless into every language possible, we do have to be somewhat selective, unfortunately. How we decide really comes down to data: Which global regions have the most native speakers? Which countries have high populations of gamers? By strategically targeting those communities, at least initially, we should be able to reach the highest number of players and ensure that playing our game is as frictionless as possible!

notes.title: Developer Update: Soul Mirror
notes.notes:
Since our last playtest, our developers have been working hard on lots of exciting updates that you’ll be able to experience very soon!

We wanted to share some of the key things we’ve been working on, along with insights from the team.

This week, we’re taking a deep dive into the Soul Mirror.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/f9ee6b99f879e9f40034fe007093d0073985fc4a.png 

We're really excited to bring more functionality back to the Safehouse. In the last playtest, use of the Soul Mirror was temporarily removed, but for our next big playtest (TBA), it will be returning!

So, what’s the Soul Mirror all about, and how will it impact your gameplay experience?

Let’s hear from Calum, our UI wizard, as he breaks down the work he’s been doing on the Soul Mirror:

What is the Soul Mirror?

The Soul Mirror is the player's primary interface to their collection of characters—both Human and Demon. Here, players can equip characters, read their lore, and acquire new ones. Each character in The Bornless has their own story and can be individually levelled up, rewarding players with cosmetic unlocks and eventually unlocking a corrupted variant of the character.

On the Demon side, the Soul Mirror allows players to preview each Demon’s unique abilities, unlock rewards through levelling, and even purchase new Demons.

What have you been working on with the Soul Mirror?

The Soul Mirror system has undergone a complete overhaul. However, it isn’t just a task for the UI Team alone; it requires extensive collaboration with the 3D Design Team to create new Human and Demon characters. Our Narrative Department also plays a key role crafting intertwined stories about each character, detailing their history with Farmouth Island and what their motivations are for being there.

Meanwhile, the UI Team has been building out all the front-end functionality to smoothly navigate these systems. And, at this stage, all the necessary 2D art is also in production.

What can players expect when using the Soul Mirror?

New characters and Demons… lots of them!

We’re really looking forward to the Soul Mirror going live and rewarding players for using their favourite characters. You'll have the opportunity to preview playable Demons in detail, including breakdowns of their skills, attacks, and more.

With this update, players will also be able to buy and equip new characters and Demons—something we’re very excited for you to explore!

What were some of the biggest challenges in designing the Soul Mirror interface?

One of the main challenges we've faced is ensuring the Soul Mirror has a great user experience—not just for keyboard-and-mouse users, but also for players who prefer controllers. Ensuring the interface is intuitive and enjoyable for both input methods has been a major focus for us.

#StayUnholy
- The Bornless Team 🖤

notes.title: Livestream, Giveaways & More | Gamescom Update
notes.notes:
Hearken now, Bornless Ones!

We have some huge updates regarding our presence at Gamescom and we can't wait to share it with you!

We are happy to share that lurking around Gamescom 2024 will be the fearsome figures of Zagan and Orobas! Cosplays are the cherry on top of every gaming convention, and ours comes in the form of the first two playable demons in The Bornless.

For those who can't make it to Gamescom, we've got you covered! One of our amazing partnered Mythos Creators, Delacroix22, will be streaming The Bornless live every day at Gamescom! This will be the first time ever that we showcase our main game mode live in front of everyone, and we are super excited! If you are reading this, go and support his channel!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/4e853376276dd0d0a62fe3fde2ee289740600165.png
The Bornless will be FULLY PLAYABLE at our booth, which will be located in Hall 10.1, and we'll have enough PCs for a full lobby so don't hesitate to bring your friends. We'd love to meet and chat with as many of you as possible, so if you see someone from our team, please approach us and say hi!

We will be giving away free merchandise to our community who support us with good feedback on the demo. We will also be hosting a big giveaway at Gamescom which we will be announcing the details of it pretty soon! All you need to do to enter these giveaways is visit our booth and scan the QR code inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/31c11c14959cdd74354b817e5d52cee73a8e6c70.jpg
Don't forget the details!
Hall 10.1, Stand E-080, Koelnmesse
August 21-25, 2024
Unholy times await in Cologne, Germany.

Stay Unholy!

notes.title: CHANGELOG 10-27-2023
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions of The Bornless,

Welcome to the latest patch notes, where the mythical and the material coalesce. The denizens of our universe have whispered their needs, and the arcane energies have responded. Below you’ll find adjustments, additions, and a sprinkle of arcane lore to deepen your experience.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/961768590959333457/1167191998147600405/HighresScreenshot00094.png?ex=654d3b41&is=653ac641&hm=2520ac71f3d43f71eb680eeb57d3ec77bfecf6e6b9181ad393decee9fd37d7e5&=&width=1041&height=446

UI

 Main Menu Overhaul
 Victory/Win Screen
 You Died Screen
 Spell Selection Screen Overhaul
 New Faction and Creator Menu


GAMEPLAY

 2 New Spells: Gehenna Bomb, Primordial Shield
 New Ping Wheel
 Game Text Chat
 Botis Grab Reworked
 Interact Time for Weapons Reduced
 Reload timing for weapons reverted (now the reload bar matches with the mag insertion, rather than the full animation)
 Botis Camera Defaults Modified
 Botis Stamina Bar Removed
 Botis now has 3-speed states (alt, standard, shift)
    - Slow pace
    - Standard pace
    - Sprint pace
 Deathfog UI rework (communicates deathfog much more clearly on screen)
 Team A no longer receives 2 points at once if both teams die at the same time


VISUAL

 Updated Weapon Textures
 Updated Spell Visual Effects
 New HUD
 Eerie Delights: Something Spooky Lurks


QUALITY OF LIFE

 Ghost mode overhaul for when you die in a match
 Scarecrows in the tutorial now have the same health as a player, so you can gather damage info from there (still no head hitbox)
 Match Acceptance Popup
 UI prompts and tooltips added for the Botis gamemode
 Multiple Ping Types Added
 Auto-Ping at Temple Doors in Botis Map
 Flashlight Key Bind Option
 Updated Tutorial Cinematic


MAPS

 New Arena Map (Chthonic)
 Lighting Adjustment and Loot Spawn Adjustment on Barn Arena Map


SOUND DESIGN

 Botis Sounds Replicated
 Global Sounds Optimized
 Additional Sounds Now Replicated (spells, jumping, etc)


We appreciate your continued support and are committed to enhancing your experience in our evolving universe. As you navigate the intricacies of spellcasting and explore the depths of Chthonic, your feedback remains invaluable. Looking forward to seeing you in-game. Until then, may your spells be potent and your victories many.

- The Bornless
